home.heroSubtitle: The Kintsugi Protocol scans, isolates, and repairs the broken infrastructure of the TON ecosystem. We don't discard code because it is flawed—we restore it.

lore.step1Desc: Our AI engine analyzes the bytecode, locked liquidity, and restorability of abandoned TON smart contracts.
lore.step2Desc: We separate malicious actors from salvageable assets, building a safe foundation for future growth.
lore.step3Desc: The $GOLD treasury injects fresh liquidity into the ecosystem, restoring viability to broken code.

manifesto.title: The Golden Repair. A Manifesto.
manifesto.subtitle: We do not discard code simply because it is flawed.
manifesto.quote: In a world of disposable protocols, we bring honor back to the blockchain. We mend the broken and restore the worthy.
manifesto.pillar1Desc: We do not create noise. We restore abandoned value and liquidity on the TON network.
manifesto.pillar2Desc: The Sensei AI analyzes smart contracts to isolate malicious actors and preserve sound foundations.
manifesto.pillar3Desc: We inject fresh liquidity into fractured codebases to make them whole again.
manifesto.pillar4Desc: Holders of $GOLD direct the protocol and determine which vessels are worthy of repair.
manifesto.lineageText: Kintsugi is not just a protocol; it is a philosophy of resilience. On TON, where projects often rise and fall in seconds, we stand as the permanent anchor. We identify the fractured code of yesterday to build the robust infrastructure of tomorrow.
manifesto.visionText: A blockchain where no liquidity is ever truly lost, and no community is ever truly abandoned. Through the Sensei AI and the Golden Treasury, we transform failure into the foundation of a superior ecosystem.
